svg.title: Runs anywhere
svg.desc: The same ORION in three places, side by side, with what provides each capability. Natively on a Linux desktop or laptop, the machine itself provides the microphone and speakers, the desktop tools (xdg-open, wpctl or pactl, D-Bus, systemd), screenshots through the desktop's portal, the clipboard through pyperclip, and Whisper on the GPU. In Docker on a headless server there is no sound or desktop, so the host profile hides those tools, and the HUD in your browser, reached through an SSH tunnel or HTTPS, carries the microphone, speakers, screen, camera and clipboard; Claude Code runs inside the image with CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, a browser runs in a sidecar container, and integrations run through uvx. In Docker Desktop on macOS or Windows, host networking is turned on and the browser is the device. The host profile decides which tools exist; surfaces bring your own devices.
